newsitem.title: SYRIA: Primakov says Russia seeks bigger Mideast role.
newsitem.headline: Primakov says Russia seeks bigger Mideast role.

text.p: Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov said on Monday at the start of a Middle East tour that Russia sought to be involved more actively in advancing the faltering peace process between Israel and its Arab neighbours.
"Russia, as you know, is a sponsor of the peace process and it wants to play a more active role to push the peace process forward," Primakov told reporters on his arrival in Damascus.
"My tour is very, very important and that is proved by the political role which Syria plays and its position in the region," he added.
Primakov was welcomed on arrival at Damascus airport by Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara.
The two were to open talks later on Monday and Primakov would meet President Hafez al-Assad during his visit, officials said.

The ITAR-Tass news agency said earlier that Primakov's tour, which will also take him to Lebanon, Egypt, Jordan, Israel and the Palestinian self-ruled areas, was designed to demonstrate Moscow's support for the peace process.
